name: Send email
description: Send an email to multiple recipients

connection_url.description: Connection URL protocol://user:password@server:port, protocol can be smtp or smtp+starttls, replaces server_address, server_port, secure, username and password

secure.description: Whether this connection use TLS (default is true if server_port is 465)

username.description: Authenticate as this user to SMTP server

password.description: Authenticate with this password to SMTP server

from.description: Full name of mail sender (might be with an email address specified in <>)

body.description: Body of mail message (might be a filename prefixed with file:// to read from)

html_body.description: HTML body of mail message (might be a filename prefixed with file:// to read from)

bcc.description: Blind carbon copy recipients (separated with comma)

reply_to.description: An email address that will appear on the Reply-To field

in_reply_to.description: The Message-ID this message is replying to

convert_markdown.description: Convert body from Markdown to HTML (set content_type input as text/html too)

attachments.description: Files that will be added to mail message attachments (separated with comma)

priority.description: Set Priority level for the mail message to 'high', 'normal' (default) or 'low'
